name: Drug–Drug Cocrystal Development
description: Model drug → counterpart selection → conceptual, virtual, and thermal screening → preparation and evaluation
placeholder: Example: identify a cocrystal counterpart supported by combination-therapy evidence and a compatible dose ratio

stages.name: Research Scope and Strategy
stages.instruction: Define the model drug, combination-therapy objective, dose, route of administration, and solid-state properties to improve.

stages.name: Counterpart Drug Selection
stages.instruction: Assess pharmacological evidence and cocrystal compatibility separately. Review dose ratio, pharmacokinetic compatibility, and interactions. Do not infer clinical benefit.

stages.name: Conceptual Screening
stages.instruction: Assess acid–base tendencies, hydrogen-bond synthons, functional groups, and conformational complementarity. ΔpKa alone does not establish cocrystal formation.

stages.name: Computational and Virtual Screening
stages.instruction: Review model applicability, formation propensity, intermolecular interactions, and thermodynamic evidence. Do not report a probability without a calibrated model.

stages.name: Thermal Screening
stages.instruction: Distinguish predicted phase behavior from measured DSC/TGA. Plan validation of phase diagrams, stoichiometry, and solid-state transitions.

stages.name: Cocrystal Preparation Planning
stages.instruction: Select among grinding, slurry, and evaporation approaches based on evidence and required data. Do not invent executable experimental conditions.

stages.name: Characterization and Feedback
stages.instruction: Plan PXRD, DSC, composition, impurity phases, dissolution, stability, and repeatability assessment. Do not call an unknown pair negative without specific experimental conditions.

stages.name: Evidence and Experimental Review
stages.instruction: Review evidence for a new phase, improved properties, and therapeutic benefit. Specify grounds for changing conditions or replacing candidates.

stages.name: Research Deliverable and Next Steps
stages.instruction: Summarize actual outputs and gaps. A new solid form is not automatically a new chemical entity, patentable invention, or therapeutic advantage.
